# AAIF assessment and design receipt

Baseline: `2fc2fe715456a432b0858fa9e24bb3565ce143c2`. This change delivers research,
vision/goal G15, decision 0034, acceptance design and queued work, not integrations.
The [assessment](../../../assessments/2026-10-23-aaif-alignment.md) records all ten
upstream projects, exact discovery pins, source links, current kit seams and gaps.

## Verification scope

- Official Linux Foundation announcement dated 2026-10-22 and AAIF directory confirm
  four additions and ten hosted projects. Three scoped source researchers covered
  the new formats, execution/evaluation systems and six existing projects.
- [Independent design review](design-review.md) found three issues: overcoupled profile
  dependencies, overbroad sandbox-test language and an under-specified paired task.
  All were corrected and independently rechecked. Each future pilot selects only its
  applicable interface, compares the same task/profile and scopes runtime claims to
  named probes under a recorded threat model.
- `TMPDIR=/Volumes/m2ext/tmp/agentic-kit-build task validate` passed, exit 0. No Go,
  CUE, gate, dependency or exported library API changed. Downstream consumer checks
  were not required or claimed.
- Strict verification parsed the [AF work order](../../../plans/aaif-alignment.md):
  ten rows, zero claimed. Exit 0 is not implementation proof. Existing AF-2/AF-3
  library anchors have unknown product wiring and no attested runtime receipt;
  their qualification entrypoints remain future work. No waiver was added.
- New relative Markdown targets and intent budgets were checked: router 80 lines,
  scope 150, futures 145, decision 0034 below 80. No changelog line was added because
  the delivery changes no executable behavior, config contract or compatibility tier.

Local verification logs: `/Volumes/m2ext/tmp/agentic-kit-aaif/validate.log` and
`plan-verify.json`. They are local diagnostics; the committed specifications and
review dispositions are the durable record. Firecrawl rejected its token; official
web and repository reads supplied research. Fathom's O11 raw/incomplete obligations
and unrelated H7 spec binding were recorded as instrument limitations.

## Remaining work and authority

G15 is open. AF-1..3 are queued qualification work, AF-4 waits for receiver/profile
selection, and AF-5..10 retain typed revival conditions. The two-slot ceiling and
W1-W4 prerequisites remain unchanged. Existing MCP revision decision 0003 stands.
F21 records optional external integration futures; AAIF hosting of this kit also
requires D4/public-readiness ratification. No services, third-party code, host installs,
live models, consumer migrations, public submissions or affiliation changes occurred.
No model quality, runtime isolation, multi-provider parity or economic benefit is claimed.
